get.summary: Discover communities by verifiable ordering
get.description: Ordering uses only checkable facts: member count or creation time. Highest mining power, fastest growing, and most discussed have no backend and are not offered. `verification=all` additionally shows communities the caller created or joined. `membership=joined` lists only the caller's current non-owner memberships (active or muted, never banned) and `membership=owned` the communities the caller owns; either combines with every `sort`. Each row carries the caller's `viewerMembership` and the `boundAsset` registry summary (Decision 0099), read for the whole page with one set-based query each.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: members and newest order by a stored column and are always available. miningPower orders by the community's power under the latest complete Mining snapshot, activity by the messages the community-channel lane observed in the official channel over the last 7 days (Decision 0061). When that fact does not exist the response is 200 with ordering.status = unavailable, an empty items array and a null cursor; the client shows the unavailable state for that segment and must not treat the empty page as 'no communities'.

parameters.name: membership
parameters.description: `joined` narrows the page to the caller's admin/member memberships and `owned` to the communities the caller currently owns (each row then carries `application`); both are cursor-paged continuations of the home aggregate and a community is in exactly one of them (Decision 0073).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to the authenticated owner, route, and canonical filter. It carries the page size, so limit and cursor are mutually exclusive.

post.summary: Join a community
post.description: Idempotent join. `member_count` is maintained inside the same transaction, so concurrent joins can neither lose nor double count. A banned account is PERMISSION_DENIED. The body is optional (Decision 0115): `{ "notifications": "muted" }` asks the channel sync lane to mute the official channel for this member server-side once it has added the member to Stream; no body, `{}`, or `null` is `default`. A muted join binds the preference into the idempotency digest, so the same key with a different preference is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Poll GET /v2/communities/{communityId}/membership for `channelSynced`.

notifications.description: The official-channel notification preference. `muted` is applied server-side by the channel sync lane right after it adds the member to the Stream channel; clients must not mute the channel themselves before `channelSynced` (GET /v2/communities/{communityId}/membership). Recorded only when this join creates the membership; an existing membership keeps its preference. Default `default`.

get.summary: List community members grouped by role
get.description: Owner first, then admins, then members; inside a group the earliest join comes first. Each row carries `actions`: the governance commands this viewer may run against that row, computed from the actor x action x target permission matrix and the row's stored state, so a client renders exactly that list and derives nothing. Segment counts come from the server and always describe the whole non-banned directory, so they do not shrink while `q` narrows the page. Per-member mining power and the online count stay unavailable. `role=banned` is the owner/admin governance view that lists banned memberships (`status: "banned"`), which no other view contains. `q` narrows the page to a member alias prefix, draws on the shared public alias search quota, and is bound into the cursor.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: `all`, `owner`, and `admin` list active and muted memberships only. `banned` is the governance view of the banned memberships and is available to an owner or admin only; any other viewer receives PERMISSION_DENIED. The segment counts stay the counts of the non-banned directory.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Member alias prefix. After trimming, NFKC normalization, lower-casing, and ASCII-space folding it must contain 1-40 Unicode code points; the match is a literal prefix of the member alias and never a substring. A member without an alias is never a hit. The query is bound into the cursor, so continuing a page after `q` changed is INVALID_REQUEST, and each request draws on the shared public alias search quota.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to the authenticated owner, route, and canonical filter. It carries the page size, so limit and cursor are mutually exclusive.

get.summary: Get a token logo through the LOOP logo proxy
get.description: Public image resource (Decisions 0089, 0161); no authentication and no LOOP headers. The server picks the picture by the Decision 0072 origin rules (on BSC the DexScreener image of the token's own base pair when the pair fact has one, else the Trust Wallet assets-repository file of the chain), fetches it once with a 5 s timeout, re-encodes it into a 128 x 128 WebP (transparency kept), and keeps it for 7 days; the worker pre-warms the mainstream, registry, watchlisted and hot BSC tokens. An operator picture (`source = manual`) is served until cleared. 200: `image/webp` bytes (rows stored before Decision 0161 may still answer PNG/JPEG/GIF until their refresh) with a strong `ETag`; `If-None-Match` answers 304. 404 `NOT_FOUND`: no origin has a picture, the upstream picture is larger than 4 MiB or cannot be decoded (remembered for 24 h). 502 `PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE`: the upstream timed out or failed and nothing is stored. On any non-200 the client draws its monogram and does not retry in a loop.

post.summary: Re-read the account's wallets from Privy now
post.description: Decision 0185. Call after Privy siwe.link / siwe.unlink. Reads Privy immediately (never the short reuse window GET /v2/wallets uses), reconciles the inventory, and answers the same list as GET /v2/wallets plus the optional externalWalletLimit / archivedReason keys. An unlinked wallet is archived (unlinked) and stops mining at once: the current hour's settlement and every later snapshot no longer attribute it. A newly linked external wallet beyond externalWalletLimit, or one that is an active wallet of another LOOP account, is stored archived (external_limit_exceeded / address_conflict) and never mines. Idempotent: no body, no Idempotency-Key; repeating it re-reads Privy and converges on the same list.

get.summary: Get the wallet's net worth history and 24 h change
get.description: Decision 0145. Hourly USD net worth snapshots of one of the caller's wallets, downsampled per range (1d hourly, 7d every 4 h, 30d daily, 180d every 3 days, 360d weekly; at most 120 points), plus the current value (valued live like the balances netWorth, falling back to the newest snapshot), the change against the snapshot 24 h earlier, the range high / low, and an optional CNY amount at the configured fixed rate. A wallet that is not the caller's is NOT_FOUND. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode WALLET_NETWORTH_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE when the snapshots cannot be read, WALLET_NETWORTH_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE when neither a live value nor a snapshot exists.

get.summary: Read the caller's fixed-template Hooks project configuration
get.description: Decision 0108. Owner-scoped latest off-chain draft (null when none). A project the caller does not own is NOT_FOUND. Reading never publishes or activates a contract. Decision 0120: also returns approval (null without a draft; status approved only when the operator approved this draft version with the same configHash, otherwise awaiting_approval — saving a new version goes back to awaiting_approval), latestDeployment (the newest deployment task of the project, any version and status, same shape as GET hooks-deployments/{jobId}; null when none) and minSaleLeadSeconds (HOOKS_LAUNCH_MIN_SALE_LEAD_SECONDS: the earliest accepted nftSaleStartAt is now + this). Decision 0122: approval.status rejected (a reviewer rejected this version; approval.rejection = {reasonCode, note, at}; saving a new version resubmits it), buybackRecipientFixed (always true) and fixedBuybackRecipient (LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT, null when not configured). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_DISABLED) while HOOKS_LAUNCH_ENABLED is off or no database is configured.

nftImageAssetUrl.description: Decision 0173: present only when the saved config carries a project NFT picture (canonical: the IPFS gateway URL when pinned).

fixedEconomics.description: Server-derived immutable hooks_launch_v1 economics. Raw amounts are 18-decimal smallest-unit strings; bps and seconds are small bounded integers.

nftSaleDurationSeconds.description: Decision 0119: the target Factory's nftSaleDuration() when the config was saved (3600 on the BSC Testnet 1-hour Factory; 604800 on mainnet / pre-S141 Factories, whose configHash is unchanged). Part of fixedEconomicsHash.

maxDynamicFeeWad.description: Decision 0144: the Factory's dynamic sell rate cap, a raw 18-decimal integer read from the Factory, never hard-coded: 500000000000000000 = 50 % (S242 ruling; the sell side totals at most 51 % with the base sell fee), 200000000000000000 = 20 % on S193 Factories; 0 = uncapped. Absent on templates of pre-S193 Factories.

maxCumulativeBuy.description: Decision 0152: the Factory's per-address curve purchase cap `maxCumulativeBuy()`, a raw MEME integer (5000000000000000000000000 = 5,000,000 MEME). Absent on templates of pre-S209 Factories.

buyFeeToken.description: Decision 0152: which side the 2 % buy fee is taken from — `usd1` on S209 Factories (hook permission bits 0x10CC), `meme` before.

approval.description: Decision 0120: null without a draft. approved only when the operator approved this draft version with the same configHash; a newer save is awaiting_approval again.

status.description: Decision 0122 adds rejected: a reviewer rejected this version (see rejection); saving a new version (expectedVersion = this version) resubmits it as awaiting_approval.

rejection.description: Decision 0122 (optional in the schema, always present in answers): non-null exactly when status is rejected.

note.description: The reviewer's note to the applicant (1–500 characters; always present for other, optional otherwise).

latestDeployment.description: Decision 0120: the newest deployment task of the project (any config version, any status), as GET hooks-deployments/{jobId}; null when none.

chainId.description: The launch slot the task was signed for (LAUNCH_CHAIN_ID): 97 on BSC Testnet; 56 only while Decision 0150's LAUNCH_MAINNET_ACK is set.

status.description: Decision 0112. awaiting_executor: verified and recorded, not claimed. claimed: an executor holds the task and re-checks config, approval, deadline and nonces. broadcast: the signed deployLaunch transaction is persisted (txHash) and sent; waiting for confirmations. confirmed: enough confirmations; module verification pending. verified: every module read back and matched; activation pending. activated: LaunchPublicationGate published (NFT sale / curve may accept funds from their own start times). failed: see failure (retryable → the executor retries automatically). reorged: the receipt left the canonical chain; the same transaction is re-sent. cancelled: withdrawn before any claim (does not revoke a signature already shared).

memeAddress.description: Predicted (EIP-712-bound) MEME address; same as addresses.predicted.meme.

hookAddress.description: Predicted (EIP-712-bound) Hook address; same as addresses.predicted.hook.

txHash.description: The deployLaunch transaction hash, persisted before it is sent.

confirmations.description: Confirmations of txHash last observed by the executor.

deployed.description: Read back from the Factory after verification; null before verified.

kind.description: Executor step: created, claimed, retry_claimed, broadcast, rebroadcast, receipt_found, included, confirmed, reorg_detected, reclaimed_after_reorg, verified, activation_broadcast, activation_included, activation_reorged, activation_reverted, activation_dropped, activation_rejected, activated, failed, lease_taken_over, cancelled. fixedBuybackRecipient.description: Decision 0122 (optional in the schema, always present in answers): LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT (lower-case). null = not configured: every save, signing request and submission is 503 HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE.

put.summary: Save an owner-scoped fixed-template Hooks project draft
put.description: Decision 0108. Appends a new immutable draft version (compare-and-swap on expectedVersion; Idempotency-Key is rejected). The server derives the fixed hooks_launch_v1 economics and configHash; economic override keys are INVALID_REQUEST. Decision 0119: fixedEconomics.nftSaleDurationSeconds is the target Factory's on-chain nftSaleDuration() (3600 on the BSC Testnet 1-hour Factory, 604800 on a 7-day / pre-S141 Factory), read before hashing; without a configured or readable Factory the save is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE), never a constant. Saving a new version invalidates any earlier approval for signing. Decision 0122: config.buybackRecipient must be the platform's fixed recipient (LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT, case-insensitive), else 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (reasonCode HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_FIXED); not configured → 503 HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE. Never publishes, deploys, or activates. Decision 0164: name and ticker follow the four.meme rule (any script, 1–20 UTF-16 units after NFC + trim, never upper-cased); while the configured Factory predates S242 (probed on chain, lifted automatically once an S242 Factory is configured) a ticker outside ^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$ is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_TICKER_UNSUPPORTED_BY_FACTORY, field ticker); an unreadable probe is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE).

expectedVersion.description: Compare-and-swap: the latest saved version (0 when none). A stale value answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

name.description: Decision 0164 (four.meme rule, same for name and ticker): any language or script (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, emoji, mixed, spaces inside, `$`, lower case, leading digit); NFC-normalised and trimmed, then 1–20 UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string length) and at most 80 UTF-8 bytes; never upper-cased and not unique. Decision 0168: must contain at least one visible letter, digit, symbol or punctuation character (detailsSafe.reasonCode TEXT_NOT_VISIBLE), tag characters only inside a 🏴 flag sequence (TAG_OUTSIDE_FLAG), and must not start with a combining mark or variation selector (LEADING_COMBINING_MARK); these three refusals answer 400 INVALID_REQUEST with detailsSafe { reasonCode, field } on /v2/launch routes. Refused: control, bidi-override and other format characters (except the emoji zero-width joiner between characters and the emoji tag characters), line / paragraph separators, spaces other than U+0020 / U+3000, invisible fillers and noncharacters.

ticker.description: Decision 0164 (four.meme rule, same for name and ticker): any language or script (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, emoji, mixed, spaces inside, `$`, lower case, leading digit); NFC-normalised and trimmed, then 1–20 UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string length) and at most 80 UTF-8 bytes; never upper-cased and not unique. Decision 0168: must contain at least one visible letter, digit, symbol or punctuation character (detailsSafe.reasonCode TEXT_NOT_VISIBLE), tag characters only inside a 🏴 flag sequence (TAG_OUTSIDE_FLAG), and must not start with a combining mark or variation selector (LEADING_COMBINING_MARK); these three refusals answer 400 INVALID_REQUEST with detailsSafe { reasonCode, field } on /v2/launch routes. Refused: control, bidi-override and other format characters (except the emoji zero-width joiner between characters and the emoji tag characters), line / paragraph separators, spaces other than U+0020 / U+3000, invisible fillers and noncharacters. The ticker is stored and signed exactly as typed (after NFC + trim); the S242 launch factories return it unchanged from symbol().

nftImageAssetUrl.description: Decision 0173: optional project NFT picture — the `url` POST /v2/media/project-nft-images returned (the IPFS gateway URL `<IPFS_GATEWAY_BASE_URL>/<cid>` when pinned), or the absolute `<PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/v2/media/<mediaId>.webp` of that upload. It must be the caller's own `project_nft_image` upload (422 VALIDATION_FAILED MEDIA_NOT_OWNED otherwise); the saved config keeps its canonical form (the gateway URL when the picture is pinned); the CID is kept server-side (never in this resource). Absent = no NFT picture: the App and the NFT metadata fall back to the logo, and the configHash stays byte-identical to a draft without the key. When present it is appended to the signed configHash tuple (`…, bytes32 fixedEconomicsHash, string nftImageAssetUrl`). Each save is a whole config: omitting it clears it.

buybackRecipient.description: Per-project MEME buyback recipient. A configuration value, never an operator or deployer identity.

get.summary: Prepare the owner's BSC Testnet Hooks deployment signature
get.description: Decision 0108. Owner-scoped, BSC Testnet (97) only. Resolves the opaque walletId in the caller's active wallet inventory, reads the latest draft and the Factory nonce (Factory code hash verified on every call), and returns EIP-712 typed data, the mined MEME salt (address suffix 6666) and Hook CREATE2 salt (permission bits 0x20CC; Decision 0132: 0x10C4 — Decision 0152: 0x10CC for an S209 LoopDynamic Factory, by its template — and typedData.message.templateHash = the LoopDynamic Factory TEMPLATE_HASH with HOOKS_LAUNCH_HOOK_KIND=loopDynamic). Never signs, stores, or broadcasts. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: HOOKS_LAUNCH_DISABLED (switch off), HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE (Factory not configured, RPC/code check failed, salt search exhausted, or busy: Retry-After 5), HOOKS_FACTORY_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH (Decision 0119: the saved config's fixedEconomics.nftSaleDurationSeconds is not the Factory's nftSaleDuration(); Decision 0132: or the config was hashed for another Hook kind / template; re-save the config and get it approved again), HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE (Decision 0122: no fixed recipient configured). 422 VALIDATION_FAILED HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_FIXED: the saved config names another recipient (re-save with fixedBuybackRecipient). Decision 0127: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED HOOKS_CONFIG_VERSION_USED: the Factory already recorded a launch for (this wallet, this configVersion) — a draft saved before versions were allocated per owner; save the config again (a new owner-unique version) and get it approved. request.configVersion is unique across all projects of the owner, so it may skip numbers within one project. Decision 0160: all Factory reads of one request share an 8 s budget (inside the 15 s request timeout) and run concurrently where independent; a slow or failing RPC is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE). The request never writes or reserves anything, so a timeout leaves nothing behind. Decision 0164: name and ticker follow the four.meme rule (any script, 1–20 UTF-16 units after NFC + trim, never upper-cased); while the configured Factory predates S242 (probed on chain, lifted automatically once an S242 Factory is configured) a ticker outside ^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$ is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_TICKER_UNSUPPORTED_BY_FACTORY, field ticker); an unreadable probe is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE).

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data (domain 'LOOP Launch Factory' v1, chainId = the launch slot: 97 on BSC Testnet, 56 only under Decision 0150's LAUNCH_MAINNET_ACK, primaryType LaunchRequest) for the project wallet to sign. uint64/uint256 message fields are decimal strings.

post.summary: Verify and record a project-signed Testnet deployment task
post.description: Decision 0108. Requires the latest config version to carry an independent operator approval (else 403 POLICY_BLOCKED, reasonCode HOOKS_CONFIG_NOT_APPROVED). Verifies the project wallet's low-S EIP-712 signature, deadline (<= 1 hour), Factory nonce, and both CREATE2 predictions, then creates or renews one awaiting_executor task. Exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the same task; a different body under the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Never broadcasts or activates; the response never contains the signature. Decision 0119: a config whose fixedEconomics.nftSaleDurationSeconds differs from the Factory nftSaleDuration() is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (reasonCode HOOKS_FACTORY_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH), nothing recorded. Decision 0122: a config naming another buyback recipient than LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_FIXED); none configured is 503 HOOKS_BUYBACK_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE; nothing recorded. Decision 0155: all Factory reads of one submission share an 8 s budget (inside the 15 s request timeout); a slow or failing RPC is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE) with nothing recorded, so a timed-out submission never leaves a task behind. Decision 0164: name and ticker follow the four.meme rule (any script, 1–20 UTF-16 units after NFC + trim, never upper-cased); while the configured Factory predates S242 (probed on chain, lifted automatically once an S242 Factory is configured) a ticker outside ^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$ is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (reasonCode HOOKS_LAUNCH_TICKER_UNSUPPORTED_BY_FACTORY, field ticker); an unreadable probe is 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (HOOKS_LAUNCH_FACTORY_UNAVAILABLE).

status.description: Decision 0112. awaiting_executor: verified and recorded, not claimed. claimed: an executor holds the task and re-checks config, approval, deadline and nonces. broadcast: the signed deployLaunch transaction is persisted (txHash) and sent; waiting for confirmations. confirmed: enough confirmations; module verification pending. verified: every module read back and matched; activation pending. activated: LaunchPublicationGate published (NFT sale / curve may accept funds from their own start times). failed: see failure (retryable → the executor retries automatically). reorged: the receipt left the canonical chain; the same transaction is re-sent. cancelled: withdrawn before any claim (does not revoke a signature already shared).

post.summary: Create a Launch application draft
post.description: Creates a `draft` project owned by the caller: name, ticker, narrative, and official links. Decision 0120: optional `kind` (ido default | launch2) marks a MEME v2 project from the start. Attachments and KYB have no Provider and stay unavailable. Review is never self-served; only the Dev-only operator script `pnpm launch:review` advances it and writes the audit row.

name.description: Decision 0164 (four.meme rule, same for name and ticker): any language or script (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, emoji, mixed, spaces inside, `$`, lower case, leading digit); NFC-normalised and trimmed, then 1–20 UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string length) and at most 80 UTF-8 bytes; never upper-cased and not unique. Decision 0168: must contain at least one visible letter, digit, symbol or punctuation character (detailsSafe.reasonCode TEXT_NOT_VISIBLE), tag characters only inside a 🏴 flag sequence (TAG_OUTSIDE_FLAG), and must not start with a combining mark or variation selector (LEADING_COMBINING_MARK); these three refusals answer 400 INVALID_REQUEST with detailsSafe { reasonCode, field } on /v2/launch routes. Refused: control, bidi-override and other format characters (except the emoji zero-width joiner between characters and the emoji tag characters), line / paragraph separators, spaces other than U+0020 / U+3000, invisible fillers and noncharacters.

ticker.description: Decision 0164 (four.meme rule, same for name and ticker): any language or script (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, emoji, mixed, spaces inside, `$`, lower case, leading digit); NFC-normalised and trimmed, then 1–20 UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string length) and at most 80 UTF-8 bytes; never upper-cased and not unique. Decision 0168: must contain at least one visible letter, digit, symbol or punctuation character (detailsSafe.reasonCode TEXT_NOT_VISIBLE), tag characters only inside a 🏴 flag sequence (TAG_OUTSIDE_FLAG), and must not start with a combining mark or variation selector (LEADING_COMBINING_MARK); these three refusals answer 400 INVALID_REQUEST with detailsSafe { reasonCode, field } on /v2/launch routes. Refused: control, bidi-override and other format characters (except the emoji zero-width joiner between characters and the emoji tag characters), line / paragraph separators, spaces other than U+0020 / U+3000, invisible fillers and noncharacters. The ticker is stored and signed exactly as typed (after NFC + trim); the S242 launch factories return it unchanged from symbol().

narrative.description: Decision 0154: any language or script; NFC-normalised, CRLF folded to LF, trimmed; at most 2000 characters; line feeds and tabs kept, other control and format characters refused except the emoji zero-width joiner and tag characters.

communityId.description: Decision 0125: the community the MEME binds to once it is deployed (the launch2_event lane registers the MEME in the Asset Registry and sets that community's bound asset when it is unbound and the owner still owns it). The caller must be the community's active owner and the community must not be rejected, else 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with detailsSafe.reasonCode LAUNCH_COMMUNITY_NOT_OWNED. On create: absent or null = none (only a named community joins the idempotency digest). On replace: absent keeps the stored value, null clears it, an unchanged ID is not re-checked.

kind.description: Decision 0120: ido (default when absent) or launch2 (MEME v2). A first Hooks config save also makes a project launch2; it never goes back. Part of the idempotency digest.

post.summary: Prepare a Launch purchase, claim, or refund Intent
post.description: Decision 0077. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with the unchanged body while BSC_WRITES_ENABLED is off or the Launch contract keys are blank. Otherwise every 06 §4.1 buy() check runs server-side at one snapshot block (LIVE, round window, not paused, minPurchase, wallet round/project caps, round/hard cap, deadline, allowlist proof) and the Decision 0065 canary applies with USD1 at 1 USD; a refusal carries detailsSafe.reasonCode. The 201 binds every 03 §8.2 field and the unsigned buy() transaction for the device signing exit. Idempotency-Key replays the same Intent. Separate from wallet intents; no sell or redeem exists. Decision 0087: body kind (default buy) also admits claim and claimRefund with walletId only. Both read the 0085 sale snapshot and getPosition at one block. claim needs entitlementState VESTING or COMPLETED, operationalState ACTIVE, and claimableTokens > 0; claimRefund needs saleState FAILED or CANCELLED with entitlementState REFUNDING, ACTIVE, and refundableUsd1 > 0. Refusals are 409 DATA_STALE with detailsSafe.reasonCode LAUNCH_CLAIM_NOT_OPEN, LAUNCH_REFUND_NOT_OPEN, LAUNCH_SALE_PAUSED, LAUNCH_NOT_PARTICIPANT, LAUNCH_NOTHING_TO_CLAIM, or LAUNCH_NOTHING_TO_REFUND. The 201 carries kind, roundId and roundIndex null, and the unsigned claim(saleId) / claimRefund(saleId) transaction.

post.summary: Prepare a LoopRewardClaim claim (EIP-712 voucher + unsigned transaction)
post.description: Decision 0116: reads nonces(wallet) and claimed(w) on chain, signs Claim(wallet, cumulativeAmount, nonce, deadline = now + 600 s) with cumulativeAmount = claimed(wallet) + (settled − Σ claimed over the caller's claim wallets), simulates, checks gas, and returns the unsigned claim(...) transaction for device_eth_send_transaction (nothing is signed or sent server-side as a transaction). Every prepare signs a fresh voucher; an older one dies by nonce once any claim lands. 409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: MINING_CLAIM_NOTHING_TO_CLAIM | MINING_CLAIM_BELOW_MINIMUM (minimumRaw, claimableRaw) | CLAIM_GAS_INSUFFICIENT (requiredNativeAmount, suggestedSwapFromSymbol USDT, suggestedSwapFromAssetId, suggestedSwapToSymbol BNB, suggestedSwapToAssetId, suggestedSwapToAmount) | CLAIM_NO_GAS_SOURCE (requiredNativeAmount). 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT: MINING_CLAIM_IN_FLIGHT (claimId) | MINING_CLAIM_LEDGER_MISMATCH. 409 SIMULATION_FAILED: MINING_CLAIM_SIMULATION_REVERTED. 422 MINING_CLAIM_WALLET_NOT_EMBEDDED. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: MINING_SETTLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE | MINING_CLAIM_MAINNET_CLOSED | MINING_CLAIM_CONTRACT_NOT_CONFIGURED | MINING_CLAIM_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED | MINING_CLAIM_SIGNER_NOT_CONFIGURED | MINING_CLAIM_WRITES_DISABLED | MINING_CLAIM_CONTRACT_PAUSED | MINING_CLAIM_FUNDING_INSUFFICIENT | MINING_CLAIM_CHAIN_READ_FAILED. Idempotency-Key replays the same claim.

post.summary: Report the hash of a sent claim transaction
post.description: Decision 0116: reads the receipt; only the contract's Claimed(wallet, amount, cumulativeAmount, nonce) log matching the voucher proves the claim. Not found → submitting; mined with fewer than MINING_CLAIM_CONFIRMATIONS → confirming; confirmed → succeeded (the ledger's claimed total moves by the logged amount, once); reverted → failed (balance untouched). Re-reporting the same hash is idempotent; a different hash on a claim that already has one is 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT / MINING_CLAIM_TRANSACTION_CONFLICT; a mined transaction without this voucher's log is 409 DATA_STALE / MINING_CLAIM_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH (nothing recorded). 404 NOT_FOUND / MINING_CLAIM_NOT_FOUND. The worker keeps re-checking submitting / confirming claims.

get.summary: Get the user, community, or referral ranking
get.description: scope=users|communities|referrals. users and communities use only complete server snapshots under the formula version in force: every account in the snapshot (or every bound community with an approved weight), positive power first by rank() with shared positions on ties, zero power after it with position null. referrals (Decision 0100) is live from PostgreSQL: inviters ranked by direct invitees in force (referral_edges depth 1, effective_to null, any validation status), only inviters with at least one; it does not wait for a snapshot. Pages: limit 1-50 (default 30), nextCursor bound to the caller and scope, at most 500 rows over a cursor chain; cursor and limit together are 400. Display rule (Decision 0049): alias (with avatarRef) unless the row's owner is in anonymous mode and is not the viewer; otherwise the anonymous member label. me is the caller's own {rank, value} on the requested scope (value = power, or the invitee count as a decimal string; communities: the best-ranked community the caller is a non-banned member of, with communityId), null when unranked. myPosition is kept for older clients (MINING_RANK_NOT_APPLICABLE on communities and referrals). formula is the version in force; snapshot is the same block as the summary, with stale and latestAttempt (Decision 0057).

get.summary: Get the caller's invite code, link, binding, counts, and boost
get.description: Issues the account's invite code on first read (one per account, random, unique, LOOP-XXXXC). Decision 0162 adds `inviteLink` ({PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/i/{code}), `stats` (direct / valid / depth 2..5 counts; valid = own power > 0 in the newest settled hour) and an available `boost` (the caller's referral power of the newest settled mining hour, all five levels). Before the first settled hour the boost stays unavailable with MINING_REFERRAL_BOOST_PENDING (Decision 0046). Decision 0162 §E: in `levels[].counts`, `valid` uses the same source as `stats.validCount` (the invitee's own power > 0 in the newest settled hour); every other in-force edge keeps its stored pending_* status. Decision 0181: the claim window has no deadline; `rules.claimWindowDays` and `binding.claimWindow.closesAt` are deprecated compatibility keys.

post.summary: Create a MEME token draft
post.description: Creates a draft the caller then deploys with a create Intent (Decision 0101). name and symbol under the shared launch token text rule (Decisions 0164 / 0168: any script, NFC + trim, 1-20 UTF-16 units, at least one visible character), description <= 500, imageMediaId an upload of the caller (POST /v2/media/community-logos), links https only; otherwise 422 VALIDATION_FAILED / MEME_METADATA_INVALID (detailsSafe.field; detailsSafe.textReasonCode TEXT_NOT_VISIBLE | TAG_OUTSIDE_FLAG | LEADING_COMBINING_MARK when only the Decision 0168 visibility rule refused the name / symbol) or MEME_IMAGE_NOT_OWNED. A CREATE2 salt is reserved from the vanity pool (vanity true, the address ends in the configured suffix) or drawn at random (vanity false). The 201 is the token detail with metadataHash, salt, and predictedAddress. MEME_CREATE_DAILY_LIMIT drafts per account per rolling 24 hours: 429 RATE_LIMITED / MEME_CREATE_RATE_LIMITED (detailsSafe.dailyLimit). Idempotency-Key replays the same draft. Retired by Decision 0151: 410 MEME_CLASSIC_LAUNCH_RETIRED (nothing written) unless MEME_CLASSIC_CREATE_ENABLED is true; launches go through /v2/launch2. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode while the meme contract is not configured (MEME_CONTRACT_NOT_CONFIGURED / MEME_USD1_NOT_CONFIGURED) or the store is unreachable.

symbol.description: Decision 0164: same rule as the name — any script, NFC + trim, 1–20 UTF-16 units, never upper-cased.

get.summary: List the week's best MEME trades
get.description: Decision 0142: at most 10 (wallet, token) pairs ranked by realized USD1, highest first. realizedUsd1 = the wallet's curve sell proceeds of the token in the last 7 days − the tokens sold × the wallet's average curve buy price of that token (all its buys up to the computation time); only positive results. Curve (inner market) trades only: DEX swaps of graduated classic MEME tokens are not indexed. A pair without a curve buy has no cost basis and is left out. The wallet must belong to a LOOP account with an active public profile and a trade history visible to everyone; anonymous wallets never appear. Operator-hidden tokens are left out. The same for every caller; computed on read and cached for 5 minutes per API process (observedAt is the computation time). window accepts only 7d (default). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode while the meme contract is not configured (MEME_CONTRACT_NOT_CONFIGURED / MEME_USD1_NOT_CONFIGURED) or the store is unreachable.

get.description: docs/10 §2 recomputed with BigInt integer math (rounded down for the user) on the curve read from the launch slot (basis chain, 1.5-second cache) or, when the chain is unreadable, the indexed snapshot (basis loop_indexer). post.summary: Prepare a MEME create, buy, or sell Intent
post.description: Decision 0101 (the Decision 0077 discipline). create: the creator deploys their draft (createToken with the reserved salt and metadataHash, optional first buy usd1Amount); a salt already used on chain is replaced first. buy: usd1Amount (fee included). sell: tokenAmount. Every docs/10 check runs at one snapshot block: curve TRADING (409 DATA_STALE MEME_CURVE_FULL / MEME_CURVE_NOT_TRADING), minimum buy 1 USD1 (422 MEME_BELOW_MIN_BUY), wallet cap 40,000,000 tokens (422 MEME_WALLET_CAP_EXCEEDED), balances (409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE MEME_USD1_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT / MEME_SELL_EXCEEDS_BALANCE / MEME_GAS_INSUFFICIENT), minOut <= quote (422 MEME_MIN_OUT_ABOVE_QUOTE), and the Decision 0065 canary (403 POLICY_BLOCKED) with USD1 at par. When the USD1 (buy/create) or token (sell) allowance towards the curve is short, approval carries an exact approve to sign first (nonce N; the call is N+1). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / MEME_WRITES_DISABLED while BSC_WRITES_ENABLED is off and MEME_MAINNET_SIGNING_CLOSED on chain 56. Idempotency-Key replays the same Intent. Decision 0151: kind create answers 410 MEME_CLASSIC_LAUNCH_RETIRED (nothing written) unless MEME_CLASSIC_CREATE_ENABLED is true; buy and sell are unchanged.

usd1Amount.description: buy: required, USD1 to spend (fee included). create: optional first buy. sell: not allowed.

tokenAmount.description: sell: required, tokens to sell. Not allowed otherwise.

minOut.description: Optional raw minimum output; mutually exclusive with slippageBps. Must not exceed the quote.

post.summary: Report the device broadcast of a MEME Intent
post.description: Same discipline as the Launch report (Decision 0077): prepared → broadcast_reported with the main transaction's hash (not the approve's), verified against the sealed payload when the launch slot already sees it (mismatch: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED / MEME_TX_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH). spotPriceUsd1.description: Decision 0122: v2 executors only; null for v3.

keeper.description: Decision 0121 (optional, additive): the server-side buyback keeper's newest attempt; null before the keeper ever simulated this instance. `lastResult` rejected = the contract refused the simulation (nothing sent; `reasonCode` says why, e.g. LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_SPOT_OUTSIDE_PROTECTION / LAUNCH2_BUYBACK_PAUSED); pending / broadcast = a transaction in flight; confirmed = final on chain (the ledger row follows from the event lane); failed = sent or prepared but not executed. `nextEligibleAt` = earliest next try (null while in flight). balanceStatus.description: available: both balances read at balanceBlockNumber; not_graduated: curve phase (balances null, use curve); unavailable: the chain read failed or the launch slot is not configured (balanceReasonCode).

balanceReasonCode.description: unavailable only: LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED | LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED; else null.

avgCostUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL — present only while the server runs LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on. Moving-average buy cost, USD1 per MEME, decimal string (same encoding as curve.usd1Spent): the USD1 the wallet actually paid for its traded MEME (curve and official-pool buys, taxes and fees included), reduced at the average on each sell. null when the wallet has no trade, or nothing it bought is still held (all sold). Decode as an optional nullable key.

costBasisUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). USD1 cost of the MEME still held = avgCost × min(holding, traded quantity); MEME received by plain transfer adds no cost. '0' after everything was sold; null without a trade.

realizedPnlUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). Σ over sells of (USD1 actually received, net of taxes / fees − average cost of the MEME sold). Signed decimal string ('-' when a loss). null without a trade.

unrealizedPnlUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). (current price − avgCost) × holding, truncated toward zero. Price and holding are those of priceUsd1 / valueUsd1 (curve price × curve.net before graduation, pool last price × memeBalance after). Signed decimal string. '0' when nothing is held; null without a trade, without a price, when memeBalance could not be read, or when avgCost is null.

costCoverage.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). full = the wallet's trades explain its whole holding; partial = MEME moved by plain transfers (holding ≠ traded quantity, or more sold than bought), so the cost covers only the traded part; null without a trade or when memeBalance could not be read.

nftImageUrl.description: Decision 0173: OPTIONAL — present only while the server runs LAUNCH2_NFT_IMAGE_EMIT=on. The project NFT picture (https) the creator saved as nftImageAssetUrl; null when the project has none — fall back to logoUrl. Decode as an optional nullable key.

pool.description: Decision 0124 (optional in the schema, always present in answers): the official Uniswap v4 pool after graduation, from the PoolManager Swap logs of officialPoolId the launch2_event lane indexed (every swap of the pool: the in-App router, the buyback executor and any other caller). null before graduation. Volumes are the USD1 side (buy: USD1 in; sell: USD1 out before tax); taxUsd1 is the 2 % taken from sells, taxMeme from buys (exact-output swaps may be 1 wei off, see docs/frontend-v2-launch2-api.md §pool). lastPriceUsd1 = the pool price after the latest indexed swap (null until the first swap). router = LAUNCH2_POOL_ROUTER_ADDRESS (null when not configured: pool quote / prepare are then 503). get.summary: K-line of one MEME v2 instance (curve, then official pool)
get.description: Decision 0171. One price series in chain order, read from the launch2_event lane's tables only (never the chain): curve trades priced at the marginal price after the trade, launch2PriceAt(running sold supply), and after graduation the official-pool swaps (OfficialTax and LoopDynamic) at price_e18 after the swap (the pool_last_price_e18 basis). Removed (reorged) facts never count. interval 1m | 5m | 15m | 1h | 4h | 1d (default 5m), buckets UTC-aligned (floor(epoch / step) × step); limit 1..500 (default 200) newest buckets ending at the bucket of now, or the last bucket with t < before. o = the previous close (launch2PriceAt(0) before the first trade), h / l include o, c = price after the bucket's last fact; v = MEME (buys + sells), q = USD1 (curve usd1_net + pool usd1_amount), n = facts. Empty buckets are flat at the previous close (v = q = 0, n = 0), so the series has no holes from the first trade to now. No trade yet: candles [] and latest = the curve start price at activation. source curve | pool | mixed (the page's prices). 422 VALIDATION_FAILED / LAUNCH2_CANDLE_INTERVAL_INVALID | LAUNCH2_CANDLE_LIMIT_INVALID | LAUNCH2_CANDLE_BEFORE_INVALID; not activated / unknown: 404 NOT_FOUND / LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND (as the detail). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: One of 1m | 5m | 15m | 1h | 4h | 1d (default 5m); else 422 LAUNCH2_CANDLE_INTERVAL_INVALID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Buckets, 1..500 (default 200); else 422 LAUNCH2_CANDLE_LIMIT_INVALID.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Unix seconds (positive integer): only buckets with t < before (paging back). Else 422 LAUNCH2_CANDLE_BEFORE_INVALID.

source.description: Where the returned candles' prices came from: curve trades only, pool swaps only, or both (the graduation crossing). An empty page: pool once graduated, else curve.

t.description: Bucket start, unix seconds, UTC-aligned to the interval.

o.description: USD1 per MEME: the previous bucket's close (the curve start price launch2PriceAt(0) before the first trade).

h.description: Max of o and the bucket's prices.

l.description: Min of o and the bucket's prices.

c.description: Price after the bucket's last fact.

v.description: MEME traded in the bucket (buys + sells).

q.description: USD1 traded in the bucket: curve usd1_net (buy: into the reserve after tax; sell: paid out after tax) + pool swap USD1 leg.

n.description: Facts in the bucket; 0 = a flat filler bucket.

candles.description: Ascending by t; dense from the first trade's bucket to the bucket of now (or the last one before `before`), empty buckets flat at the previous close. Empty before the first trade.

latest.description: The newest fact's price and time (independent of before); with no trade the curve start price at the activation time; null for an instance on hold that never activated.

post.summary: Prepare a MEME v2 curve buy or sell
post.description: Takes the quote's amount, minOut, and deadline. A deadline in the past is 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED / LAUNCH2_QUOTE_EXPIRED (re-quote); more than 600 s ahead is 422 LAUNCH2_DEADLINE_TOO_FAR. Decision 0126: the deadline encoded in buy / sell (and the intent's deadline / expiresAt) is max(the quote's deadline, prepare time + LAUNCH2_POOL_TRADE_DEADLINE_SECONDS, default 180 s). Re-quotes at one block: an amount above the executable MAX is 422 LAUNCH2_AMOUNT_ABOVE_MAX (detailsSafe.maxAmountIn, limitedBy) or 409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE when the balance is the bound (LAUNCH2_USD1_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT with detailsSafe.maxAmountIn, balanceUsd1 | LAUNCH2_MEME_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT with maxAmountIn, balanceMeme; LAUNCH2_GAS_INSUFFICIENT with requiredBnb = the gas fee ceiling, balanceBnb); a fresh expectedOut below minOut (another order filled first) is 409 DATA_STALE / LAUNCH2_PRICE_MOVED (detailsSafe.expectedOut) — refresh the quote in place. In the priority hour a buy carries the wallet's Merkle proof from the verified snapshot (403 POLICY_BLOCKED / LAUNCH2_NOT_IN_SNAPSHOT; 503 LAUNCH2_SNAPSHOT_UNVERIFIED when the lane could not reproduce the published root). Returns buy(amountInMax, minMemeOut, deadline, proof) / sell(memeIn, minUsd1Out, deadline) unsigned, with an exact approve first when the allowance is short. The contract still enforces minOut / deadline and refunds the unused USD1. Decision 0117: the curve, the USD1 and the MEME must be the activated instance's registered contracts, else 403 POLICY_BLOCKED / LAUNCH2_COUNTERPARTY_NOT_INSTANCE; the Decision 0065 canary asset and ceilings still apply. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing. Decision 0136: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_USD1_PAUSED | LAUNCH2_ADDRESS_FROZEN (detailsSafe.since = the chain guard incident's first_seen_at) while the chain guard holds the launch chain (unresolved USD1 pause, or one of our addresses frozen; chain-wide), and CHAIN_GUARD_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE when that hold cannot be read; GET …/instances/{instanceId} shows the same hold as tradingHold.

minOut.description: From the quote: buy MEME out / sell USD1 out floor.

deadline.description: The quote's deadline (quote time + LAUNCH2_QUOTE_TTL_SECONDS, the freshness check): past it the prepare is 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED, more than 600 s ahead 422 LAUNCH2_DEADLINE_TOO_FAR. Decision 0126: the encoded on-chain deadline (and the intent's deadline / expiresAt) is max(this, prepare time + LAUNCH2_POOL_TRADE_DEADLINE_SECONDS, default 180 s), so two device signatures (approve + trade) fit.

get.summary: Quote a graduated MEME v2 buy or sell on the official v4 pool
get.description: Decision 0124. Graduated instances only: simulates OfficialPoolRouter.swapExactIn (minAmountOut 0) / swapExactOut (maxAmountIn unbounded) with eth_call from the wallet at one block (input-token balance and allowance overridden in the call only), on the PoolKey (min/max(USD1, MEME), fee 2500, tickSpacing 60, the instance hook) verified against officialPoolId. buy = USD1 → MEME, sell = MEME → USD1; the 2 % OfficialTaxHook tax is taken from the output (taxToken). minOut / maxIn apply slippageBps (default LAUNCH2_DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS); deadline = expiresAt = now + LAUNCH2_QUOTE_TTL_SECONDS (the quote's freshness; Decision 0126: the prepare re-simulates and encodes its own, longer deadline). 422 VALIDATION_FAILED / POOL_NOT_GRADUATED (detailsSafe.stage) | POOL_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE (simulation reverted; detailsSafe.revertReason) | POOL_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY | POOL_QUOTE_ZERO | LAUNCH2_AMOUNT_INVALID; 409 DATA_STALE / LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_PAUSED; 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / POOL_ROUTER_NOT_CONFIGURED | POOL_ROUTER_CODE_MISMATCH | POOL_ROUTER_MANAGER_MISMATCH | POOL_KEY_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED. Decision 0131 — a LoopDynamic instance (no Hook at deployLaunch; the per-project LoopDynamicHook bound at graduation) quotes through LoopRouter.swapExactInput instead: exactIn only (exactOut is 422 LAUNCH2_EXACT_OUT_UNSUPPORTED); taxBps = the Hook's buy fee (MEME) / base sell fee (USD1); quote.dynamic carries the dynamic sell fee (dynamicTaxBps / dynamicTaxAmount, from a second base-fee-only simulation), armed / roundId after the candle roll, and rewardWeight (a buy's USD1 while armed); router = LoopRouter — Decision 0153: the instance's own Factory's loopRouter() (an older Factory's instance quotes and prepares through its older router). Its 503 reasons are LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_NOT_CONFIGURED | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_CODE_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_FACTORY_UNKNOWN | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INDEXED | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INITIALIZED; contract errors map to 422 LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_UNAUTHORIZED | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_SWAP_UNSUPPORTED, 409 DATA_STALE / LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_BUSY. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing. Decision 0136: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_USD1_PAUSED | LAUNCH2_ADDRESS_FROZEN (detailsSafe.since = the chain guard incident's first_seen_at) while the chain guard holds the launch chain (unresolved USD1 pause, or one of our addresses frozen; chain-wide), and CHAIN_GUARD_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE when that hold cannot be read; GET …/instances/{instanceId} shows the same hold as tradingHold.

post.summary: Prepare a graduated MEME v2 buy or sell on the official v4 pool
post.description: Decision 0124. Re-quotes like GET …/pool/quote at one block (Decision 0126: a fresh simulation at the prepare block, basis = that block; the encoded deadline and the intent's deadline / expiresAt = prepare time + LAUNCH2_POOL_TRADE_DEADLINE_SECONDS, default 180 s, so the approve and the trade can both be signed) and returns the unsigned OfficialPoolRouter call for the device signing exit (to = the router, value 0, recipient = the wallet): swapExactIn(key, zeroForOne, amountIn, minOut, wallet, deadline) or swapExactOut(key, zeroForOne, amountOut, maxIn, wallet, deadline); kind pool_buy / pool_sell. approval = an exact approve of the input token (buy: USD1, sell: MEME) to the router for amountIn (exactIn) or maxIn (exactOut), null when the allowance already covers it (then the call is nonce N, else N+1). simulation = eth_call of the router call (allowance overridden while the approve is pending) and gas = its estimate × 1.2. The response carries the quote it was built from. 422 VALIDATION_FAILED / POOL_NOT_GRADUATED | POOL_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE | POOL_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY | POOL_QUOTE_ZERO | LAUNCH2_AMOUNT_INVALID | LAUNCH2_WALLET_NOT_EMBEDDED; 409 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE / LAUNCH2_USD1_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT (detailsSafe.maxAmountIn = the balance, requiredAmountIn, balanceUsd1) | LAUNCH2_MEME_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT (maxAmountIn, requiredAmountIn, balanceMeme) | LAUNCH2_GAS_INSUFFICIENT (requiredBnb = the gas fee ceiling, balanceBnb); 409 DATA_STALE / LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_PAUSED; 403 POLICY_BLOCKED (Decision 0065 canary asset / ceilings; Decision 0117 counterparties: the instance's MEME / USD1 and the code-hash-verified router only); 503 LAUNCH2_WRITES_DISABLED while BSC_WRITES_ENABLED is off and the pool quote 503 reasons. Idempotency-Key replays the same Intent. Decision 0131: a LoopDynamic instance prepares LoopRouter.swapExactInput(key, zeroForOne, amountIn, minOut, MIN/MAX_SQRT_PRICE±1, deadline) instead (exactIn only, 422 LAUNCH2_EXACT_OUT_UNSUPPORTED; the approve spender is LoopRouter; the trade pays and receives for the signing wallet); same kinds pool_buy / pool_sell and the quote's dynamic block. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing. Decision 0136: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_USD1_PAUSED | LAUNCH2_ADDRESS_FROZEN (detailsSafe.since = the chain guard incident's first_seen_at) while the chain guard holds the launch chain (unresolved USD1 pause, or one of our addresses frozen; chain-wide), and CHAIN_GUARD_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE when that hold cannot be read; GET …/instances/{instanceId} shows the same hold as tradingHold.

get.summary: List one wallet's official-pool trades of a MEME v2 instance
get.description: Decision 0126. The caller's wallet (walletId, required; 404 when it is not one of the caller's wallets) — its official-pool swaps the launch2_event lane attributed: each OfficialPoolRouter Swap(poolId, payer, recipient, …) log is paired with the PoolManager Swap of the same pool in the same transaction (the PoolManager sender must be the router, the router log follows it, the input amounts agree); the payer is the trader. Swaps that did not go through the router (the buyback executor, other routers) are never attributed. Decision 0132: on a LoopDynamic pool (LoopRouter emits no event) a swap is the wallet whose transaction called LoopRouter directly (tx.from, tx.to = the Hook trustedRouter, one swap in the transaction); amountOut is net of the Hook fee; anything else stays anonymous. Newest first; limit <= 50 (default 20). poolTradeCount / lastPoolTradeAt cover all of the wallet's attributed trades. Before graduation the list is empty. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

get.description: Decision 0174. Public: no Bearer (the LOOP read headers stay required, no Idempotency-Key). The instance's newest official-pool user swaps of every wallet (the Decision 0127 / 0158 rule: never the buyback adapter / executor or a buyback transaction), newest first by block and log index; limit 1–50 (default 20, above 50 is 400 INVALID_REQUEST). Each item: txHash, blockNumber, at (swap time), side, memeAmount, usd1Amount (buy = USD1 paid; sell = USD1 received net of a USD1 pool fee), priceUsd1 (pool price after the swap), wallet = the Decision 0126 / 0132 attributed trader masked as 0x1234…abcd, null when anonymous. Before graduation items is []. One answer per (instance, limit) is reused for 10 s (observedAt = when it was read); 200 is Cache-Control: public, max-age=10. 404 NOT_FOUND / LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND. 429 RATE_LIMITED (Retry-After seconds) above PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE requests per visitor per minute (TRUST_PROXY / PUBLIC_CLIENT_IP_HEADERS name the visitor). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

get.summary: Get the LoopDynamic pool and reward-round state of a MEME v2 instance
get.description: Decision 0131. Every instance answers its hookKind: an OfficialTax instance is status not_applicable (every other field null); a LoopDynamic instance before graduation is not_graduated. A graduated LoopDynamic instance reads its indexed Hook (LoopHookBound) at one block, cross-checked (Decision 0153) against its own Factory — a trusted one (LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_FACTORY_ADDRESS or a v3 LAUNCH2_LEGACY_FACTORIES entry): the Factory's loopHook(launchId), loopRouter() (trustedRouter, PoolManager, code hash) and routerRegistry() — and the indexed pool id (router = that Factory's LoopRouter): armed, currentRoundId, candle (5 min) and whether a roll is pending, currentDropWad, the dynamic fee cap (maxDynamicFeeWad; the sell rate is min(drop, cap), currentDynamicTaxBps) and the round close rule (Decision 0144: an armed round closes at the first candle that no longer falls — close ≥ open, flat included — on S193 Hooks; only on a rising close on pre-S193 Hooks), the pot (carry + the armed round's dynamic fees), the round's total buy weight, the viewer's weight (walletId query or the active wallet; null without one; Decision 0146: the chain's buyWeight with the projection's merged weight and weightReconciled), currentRoundBuyers (Decision 0146: the armed round's addresses by merged weight — BuyCredited + CreditMoved received − sent — with each one's attributions; any router's buy counts and is credited to the address receiving the MEME), the fee rates, routingPolicy / priceTiming, and the indexed round summary. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_NOT_CONFIGURED | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_CODE_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_FACTORY_UNKNOWN (untrusted Factory) | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_MISMATCH (the current Factory's chain router / registry differ from the configuration) | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INDEXED | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_MISMATCH | LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INITIALIZED | LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED. Decision 0132: every such dependency 503 (after the instance is read) adds detailsSafe.hookKind (officialTax | loopDynamic, the registry row) so a client whose first read fails still picks the LoopDynamic panel. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

status.description: not_applicable: OfficialTax instance (every other field null); not_graduated: LoopDynamic before graduation (no Hook yet); active: the bound Hook read at basis.

router.description: LoopRouter (the App's swap and approve target).

buyFeeToken.description: Decision 0152 (loop-contracts Decision 0015): the token of the base buy fee. usd1 — an S209 Hook (address bits 0x10CC) keeps floor(amountIn × buyTaxBps / 10,000) of the USD1 input (Hook baseFeesAccrued, withdrawn by the fee vault) and the pool swaps the rest; meme — a pre-S209 Hook (0x10C4) takes buyTaxBps of the MEME output to the fee vault. null when not active.

currentRoundId.description: The armed round (null while no round is armed).

rollPending.description: The Hook's candle ended without a swap / poke since; the next swap, poke or claim closes it first (Decision 0144: on an S193 Hook an armed round whose pending candle did not fall — flat included — closes then).

currentDropWad.description: currentDropWad() as a decimal fraction (0.3 = 30 % below the candle open); 0 when not armed or a roll is pending.

maxDynamicFeeWad.description: Decision 0144: maxDynamicFeeWad() as a decimal fraction — the dynamic sell rate is min(drop, cap); 0 = uncapped (an uncapped Factory or a pre-S193 Hook without the getter). The ruled value is 0.5 (50 %, S242; the sell side totals at most 51 % with the base sell fee); S193 Factories carry 0.2 (20 %). Read from the chain, never hard-coded.

currentDynamicTaxBps.description: Decision 0144: the dynamic sell rate at the current price, min(currentDropWad, maxDynamicFeeWad) in bps (0 = no dynamic fee). PRE_SWAP: what the next sell pays; POST_SWAP: before that sell's own price impact (the quote is exact).

roundCloseRule.description: Decision 0144: how an armed round ends. closeAtOrAboveOpen (S193 Hooks, ruled 2026-10-15): the first candle that no longer falls closes the round — close ≥ open, a flat candle included. closeAboveOpen (pre-S193 Hooks, legacy Factories): only a candle closing above its open closes it; a flat one keeps it armed. A round arms when a candle closes more than 10 % below its open.

armedAfterRoll.description: Decision 0144 (loop-contracts 0013 §7.3): whether a round is armed once the pending candle roll runs (the next swap, poke or claim). Equals armed when rollPending is false; while a roll is pending the chain's armed() is stale — on an S193 Hook an armed round ends if the pending candle did not fall or an empty candle followed it, and a crash can activate one. Use this for the App's "round in progress" and dynamic-tax hints.

potUsd1.description: carry + the armed round's dynamic fees.

weightUsd1.description: Merged weight = creditedUsd1 + movedInUsd1 − movedOutUsd1 (the chain's buyWeight(round, address)).

items.description: Decision 0146: how the weight entry came about. Any router's buy counts while a round is armed and is credited to the address that receives the MEME. loopRouter: LOOP's LoopRouter credited its caller (tier 1); registryRouter: a router listed in the LoopRouterRegistry credited its msgSender() (tier 2); delivery: any other router (PancakeSwap, wallet swaps, aggregators, scripts) — credited to the address the PoolManager delivered the MEME to; moved: a same-transaction forward of a credited recipient's MEME moved that share of weight (CreditMoved); unknown: not derivable from the indexed logs (e.g. indexed before Decision 0146). A contract wallet / smart account that receives the MEME holds the weight itself and must call claim from that address.

attributions.description: Distinct attributions of the address's incoming entries, sorted.

currentRoundBuyers.description: Decision 0146: the armed round's addresses by merged weight (indexed BuyCredited + CreditMoved received − CreditMoved sent), at most 20, heaviest first; buyerCount = all of them. Any router's buy counts and is credited to the address receiving the MEME. null when no round is armed (or not applicable).

currentRoundWeightUsd1.description: The chain's buyWeight(currentRound, wallet) at basis — the weight credited to this address as the MEME recipient (Decision 0146), 0 when no round is armed.

indexedCurrentRoundWeightUsd1.description: Decision 0146: the projection's merged weight for the same round and address (null when no round is armed).

weightReconciled.description: Decision 0146: indexedCurrentRoundWeightUsd1 = currentRoundWeightUsd1 (false while the index lags basis or on a divergence; null when no round is armed).

buyFeesMeme.description: Σ buy fees of pre-S209 Hooks (MEME).

buyFeesUsd1.description: Decision 0152: Σ buy fees of S209 Hooks (USD1, taken from the input).

parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to the authenticated owner, route, and canonical filter. It carries the page size, so limit and cursor are mutually exclusive.

minMemeOut.description: Decision 0122: the v2 (price-protected) executor's protected minimum; null for a v3 execution (no price protection, minOut 0).

referencePriceUsd1.description: Decision 0122: v2 executors only (30-minute reference price); null for v3.

spotPriceUsd1.description: Decision 0122: v2 executors only; null for v3.

get.summary: List the caller's MEME v2 NFTs and curve positions
get.description: Per instance and per wallet of the account: the minted NFT token id and NFTs held (from the NFT transfers), snapshot membership, curve bought / sold / net, and the cumulative buy that both rounds share against the 5,000,000 MEME (0.5%) cap — selling does not restore it. Decision 0126: a wallet whose only activity is official-pool trades (attributed through the router) is listed too; graduated rows carry memeBalance / usd1Balance read at one block (≤ 15 s cache, balanceStatus available | unavailable), curve-phase rows null with balanceStatus not_graduated; poolTradeCount / lastPoolTradeAt = the wallet's attributed pool trades. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

memeBalance.description: Decision 0126: MEME ERC-20 balanceOf(wallet) at balanceBlockNumber (graduated instances only; null otherwise or when the read failed).

usd1Balance.description: Decision 0126: the instance USD1 (CurveEngine.usd1()) balanceOf(wallet) at the same block; null like memeBalance.

balanceStatus.description: available: both balances read at balanceBlockNumber; not_graduated: curve phase (balances null, use curve); unavailable: the chain read failed or the launch slot is not configured (balanceReasonCode).

balanceReasonCode.description: unavailable only: LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED | LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED; else null.

poolTradeCount.description: Decision 0126: the wallet's own official-pool trades the launch2_event lane attributed through OfficialPoolRouter Swap(payer) ("0" before graduation). Use it — not pool.tradeCount — as the confirmation signal after a pool trade.

lastPoolTradeAt.description: Block time of the wallet's newest attributed pool trade.

nftImageUrl.description: Decision 0173: OPTIONAL — present only while the server runs LAUNCH2_NFT_IMAGE_EMIT=on. The project NFT picture (https) the creator saved as nftImageAssetUrl; null when the project has none — fall back to logoUrl. Decode as an optional nullable key.

priceUsd1.description: Decision 0174: OPTIONAL — present only while the server runs LAUNCH2_POSITION_VALUE_EMIT=on. USD1 per MEME, decimal string (same encoding as curve.usd1Spent). Before graduation the curve's current price (= the detail's curve.priceUsd1); after graduation the official pool's last trade price (= the detail's pool.lastPriceUsd1). null when there is no price (e.g. graduated, no pool trade yet). Decode as an optional nullable key.

valueUsd1.description: Decision 0174: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_POSITION_VALUE_EMIT=on). floor(quantity × priceUsd1), decimal string; quantity = curve.net before graduation, memeBalance after. null when priceUsd1 is null or memeBalance could not be read (balanceStatus unavailable). Never estimated.

priceSource.description: Decision 0174: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_POSITION_VALUE_EMIT=on). curve | pool — where priceUsd1 comes from; null with a null price.

avgCostUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL — present only while the server runs LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on. Moving-average buy cost, USD1 per MEME, decimal string (same encoding as curve.usd1Spent): the USD1 the wallet actually paid for its traded MEME (curve and official-pool buys, taxes and fees included), reduced at the average on each sell. null when the wallet has no trade, or nothing it bought is still held (all sold). Decode as an optional nullable key.

costBasisUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). USD1 cost of the MEME still held = avgCost × min(holding, traded quantity); MEME received by plain transfer adds no cost. '0' after everything was sold; null without a trade.

realizedPnlUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). Σ over sells of (USD1 actually received, net of taxes / fees − average cost of the MEME sold). Signed decimal string ('-' when a loss). null without a trade.

unrealizedPnlUsd1.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). (current price − avgCost) × holding, truncated toward zero. Price and holding are those of priceUsd1 / valueUsd1 (curve price × curve.net before graduation, pool last price × memeBalance after). Signed decimal string. '0' when nothing is held; null without a trade, without a price, when memeBalance could not be read, or when avgCost is null.

costCoverage.description: Decision 0176: OPTIONAL (LAUNCH2_PNL_EMIT=on). full = the wallet's trades explain its whole holding; partial = MEME moved by plain transfers (holding ≠ traded quantity, or more sold than bought), so the cost covers only the traded part; null without a trade or when memeBalance could not be read.

get.summary: Get the ERC-721 metadata of one MEME v2 project NFT
get.description: Decision 0173. Public JSON resource (ERC-721 / OpenSea metadata keys); no authentication and no LOOP headers, like the token logo proxy — the path is the stable target of a future on-chain `_baseURI` (`<base>/v2/launch2/nft/<launchId>/` + tokenId) and must not change. Body: {name: "<project name> #<tokenId>", description: the project description or a fixed LOOP sentence, image: `ipfs://<cid>` of the pinned project NFT picture, else its https URL, else the logo, else null, image_gateway: the same picture over https (IPFS gateway URL) for clients without ipfs://, attributes: [{trait_type: "Project", value: ticker}, {trait_type: "Token ID", value: tokenId}, {trait_type: "Stage", value: stage}]}. No external_url (LOOP has no public project page URL yet). 200 with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=3600` and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. 404 NOT_FOUND: LAUNCH2_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND for an unknown (or not yet activated) launch id, LAUNCH2_NFT_NOT_MINTED for a tokenId above the instance's minted count; a malformed launchId / tokenId is 400 INVALID_REQUEST. Errors are `no-store`. 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with detailsSafe.reasonCode (LAUNCH2_FACTORY_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED / LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE / LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED) while a dependency is missing.

image.description: `ipfs://<cid>` when the project NFT picture is pinned to IPFS; else its https URL (nftImageUrl), else the project logo (logoUrl), else null.

image_gateway.description: The same picture over https (the IPFS gateway URL `<IPFS_GATEWAY_BASE_URL>/<cid>` when pinned, else nftImageUrl, else logoUrl), for clients that do not resolve ipfs://; null when there is no picture.

value.description: Project: the ticker; Token ID: the token id (integer); Stage: the instance stage now.

post.summary: Send testnet tBNB and mint MockUSD1 to the caller's embedded wallet
post.description: Decision 0128: BSC Testnet only. The operator account sends TESTNET_FAUCET_BNB_AMOUNT tBNB, then calls MockUSD1.mint(address, TESTNET_FAUCET_USD1_AMOUNT); each waits for its receipt. Once per wallet address per TESTNET_FAUCET_COOLDOWN_SECONDS. 403 PERMISSION_DENIED / TESTNET_FAUCET_WALLET_NOT_OWNED. 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT / TESTNET_FAUCET_IN_FLIGHT (same key, still pending); 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. 429 RATE_LIMITED / TESTNET_FAUCET_COOLDOWN (nextAvailableAt; also after an attempted failure for TESTNET_FAUCET_FAILED_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, and until the next UTC day after 5 attempted failures of the owner). 502 PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE / TESTNET_FAUCET_TRANSFER_FAILED (nothing moved; the tBNB gas estimate reverted or the transfer was not sent / reverted; the short failed cooldown applies). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / TESTNET_FAUCET_PARTIAL (tBNB landed, USD1 did not; bnbTransactionHash, usd1TransactionHash only when that mint went out, nextAvailableAt; cooldown counts) | TESTNET_FAUCET_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN (tBNB broadcast, receipt not seen; bnbTransactionHash, nextAvailableAt; cooldown counts) | TESTNET_FAUCET_DISABLED | TESTNET_FAUCET_WRONG_CHAIN | TESTNET_FAUCET_OPERATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED | TESTNET_FAUCET_USD1_NOT_CONFIGURED | TESTNET_FAUCET_RPC_NOT_CONFIGURED | TESTNET_FAUCET_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE | TESTNET_FAUCET_OPERATOR_LOW (balance below the grant, twice the estimated gas, and, when the key is the MEME pause key, TESTNET_FAUCET_OPERATOR_RESERVE_BNB) | TESTNET_FAUCET_DAILY_LIMIT (TESTNET_FAUCET_DAILY_MAX_GRANTS or TESTNET_FAUCET_DAILY_MAX_BNB of the UTC day reached; nextAvailableAt = next UTC midnight) | TESTNET_FAUCET_USD1_UNAVAILABLE | TESTNET_FAUCET_CHAIN_READ_FAILED | TESTNET_FAUCET_BUSY. The same Idempotency-Key replays the stored outcome (the same 201 body).

post.summary: Upload an avatar picture

post.summary: Upload a MEME v2 project NFT picture
post.description: Decision 0173. multipart/form-data with one part `file`, the community-logo rules (Decision 0095): sniffed by content (JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC), <= 5 MiB, both sides >= 64 px, stored as a 512x512 cover WebP (quality 82, metadata stripped; a square picture is recommended). With NFT_IMAGE_STORAGE=filebase the stored WebP is also pinned to IPFS through Filebase before it is saved: `cid` / `ipfsUri` name the pin and `url` is the public gateway URL `<IPFS_GATEWAY_BASE_URL>/<cid>`; otherwise (local) `cid` / `ipfsUri` are null and `url` is the API-relative media path like the other uploads. `mediaUrl` is always the API-relative local copy (GET /v2/media/{mediaId}.webp), a fallback. Put `url` (absolute: prefix the API base URL when it is relative) into the Hooks launch draft's `nftImageAssetUrl`; the draft save accepts only the caller's own upload (422 VALIDATION_FAILED MEDIA_NOT_OWNED). 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / MEDIA_IPFS_UNAVAILABLE when the pin fails (nothing is stored; retry with the same Idempotency-Key). 422 reason codes, idempotency and the shared six-per-minute limit as the other upload routes.

file.description: Required, the only part. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC/HEIF by content (not by declared type), at most 5 MiB, both sides at least 64 px. Stored as 512x512 cover WebP.

url.description: The IPFS gateway URL `<IPFS_GATEWAY_BASE_URL>/<cid>` when pinned; else the API-relative media path. Use it as the draft's nftImageAssetUrl (made absolute).

mediaUrl.description: API-relative path of the local copy (fallback).

cid.description: The IPFS CID; null when stored locally only.
